alert_reason: Robinhood Chain's speculative regime strengthened further, but PONS's latest ATH is now partly attributable to a Binance Alpha listing rather than purely organic continuation. A concrete selective successful-wallet rotation from CASHCAT into PONS adds modest wallet-quality support, while current vendor price snapshots diverge sharply and no new candidate clears all hard gates.

ecosystem_evidence.interpretation: Spot turnover and stablecoin growth remain exceptional while net inflows are increasingly negative and bridge activity is strongly two-way. This continues to fit a high-velocity discretionary speculation regime more than a simple one-way deposit wave. Activity is not primarily airdrop/points driven, but Robinhood's temporary gas subsidy is a material persistence caveat.

PONS.external_catalyst: Binance Wallet added PONS to Binance Alpha on 2026-09-02; contemporary reporting attributed a fresh ATH near $0.52 and a brief market-cap expansion above $500M to the listing catalyst.

live_price_source_disagreement.interpretation: Fresh vendor snapshots are too divergent to treat any one figure as a definitive current mark without a preselected canonical source. The range indicates extreme post-listing volatility and/or source-timing differences.

selective_wallet_evidence.cashcat_history: Onchain reporting says this wallet bought $106.5K of CASHCAT and later sold all for $672.6K, realizing about $566K profit.
selective_wallet_evidence.pons_rotation: The same wallet then deployed about $113.7K into 10.2M PONS, sold 1.1M for $117.1K, and still held 9.1M PONS at the article's snapshot.
selective_wallet_evidence.confidence_effect: Positive but limited. This is one selective successful wallet, not independent-wallet convergence, and most of the marked PONS gain was unrealized at the time of reporting.

attention_quality.dexscreener_paid_promotion: PONS reportedly bought one standard DexScreener profile at launch and no subsequent boosts or ads; many copycats paid for promotion.
attention_quality.external_listing_contamination: The Binance Alpha listing is now a major non-organic attention catalyst and should be separated from ecosystem-native demand when evaluating persistence.

structure.note: No new honeypot/sellability/mint/tax failure was found in this run, but raw holder-concentration snapshots differ depending on whether LP/burn/locked addresses are excluded. Selective-wallet funding independence remains unverified.

UP.reason: Activity is heavily incentive/emissions driven: protocol incentives dwarf fee/revenue generation, only a small fraction of supply circulates, and dilution/concentration risk is high.

NET.reason: Executable liquidity is too thin relative to valuation and older holder data show extreme concentration; structure/supply data remain inconsistent.

DELTA.reason: Momentum is fading and structural verification is incomplete; independent automated checks previously flagged entrapment/quality concerns despite some otherwise clean fields.

SPACEHOOD.reason: The tokenized-SpaceX composability narrative is interesting, but it has retraced sharply from its recent peak, liquidity/holder evidence is weaker, and tokenomics documentation is insufficient.

AI.reason: Narrative/composability remains strong but the previously unresolved scanner/structural disagreement is not cleared.

INDEX.reason: Strong tokenized-stock composability, but paid-promotion contamination and unresolved wallet/LP/mint/tax checks remain blockers.

Sonic.reason: Stablecoin/inflow/perps growth is not yet matched by persistent broad spot DEX migration.

Canton.reason: DEX growth is positive but token incentives dwarf organic app fee/revenue generation.

regime_persistence_risk: Robinhood currently subsidizes gas for users through roughly late September 2026. That is not an airdrop/points campaign, but it can inflate transaction counts and capital velocity; the regime should be re-tested after the subsidy ends.
forward_test_implication: This run materially changes causal attribution without changing the frozen PONS execution record. PONS's latest high cannot be treated as purely endogenous ecosystem leadership because Binance Alpha supplied a strong external catalyst. At the same time, one demonstrably successful wallet rotating from CASHCAT into PONS is the first concrete selective-wallet evidence supporting the thesis. Future mark-to-market evaluation should use a predeclared canonical market-data source so divergent vendor snapshots cannot be cherry-picked after the fact.
